name: v2-kill-button
review: KillButton.cpp samples the active-low input at 5 Hz, broadcasts halt and emits the required alarm. During the recorded 0.5 s of motion, a 10 mm/s target and 100 mm/s² acceleration predict 4.5 mm, or 360 steps at 80 steps/mm; the trace ends there and contains no later move. Independent base and head simulator builds reproduced the trace and alarm. This validates the simulated kill-input path, not the separate M112 command or a physical emergency-stop circuit.
